verdict.rationale: Docs claim the API can 'extend Gitea's functionality... to match your unique needs' and webhooks exist, implying broad API coverage, but there is no evidence of full UI/API parity, and probes could not locate an OpenAPI/swagger spec at expected paths, undermining verifiability of comprehensive API coverage. Missing for 10: documented API endpoint parity with UI features, independent confirmation of full API surface, and a discoverable OpenAPI spec.
